extracted.name: Banana Cornbread
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Combine flour, cornmeal, milk, bananas, sugar, butter, baking powder, and salt together in a bowl until batter is smooth; pour into the prepared baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, about 30 minutes.
Brush some honey on top of the bread immediately after removing from oven (optional).
